objective: Prove a local mobility lemma for single-defect states of the bulk (the violated line can be moved to an adjacent line by changing points within a fixed radius, from every configuration), by an exhaustive two-level check on a bulk patch, or find a configuration where it fails; from it, prove that resolution refutations of the octahedral knot spaces and their three-fold decorations need width Omega(k), by a Duplicator strategy in the existential pebble game (Atserias-Dalmau) that keeps the violated line in the giant component.
status: Obstructed (SPHERE-COUNT-20261106-001A-P001, proved): the violated line can be pinned. Frozen states (concentric alternating rings) block local moves: for both classes of adjacent line and every radius up to 3 in the bulk, and on K_8 for each of the six adjacent lines of the central line at radius 2 and 3 with whole-sphere states; random states always move (149 of 149 within radius 2). So the Tseitin-style width proof cannot be applied state by state. Label states (1-Lipschitz Z6 heights through six sublattice patterns) colour every triangle not-all-equal except at vortices, and a counterclockwise vortex is exactly a violated line; width Omega(sqrt n) reduces to the flat-state pursuit lemma for label states, which is open
title: The violated line moves, and resolution width is linear in k
